flags.help: Agent profile to install
flags.name: --profile

flags.help: mDNS hostname to set
flags.name: --name

flags.help: Skip the RTL8812EU WFB radio driver build
flags.name: --no-rtl-driver

flags.help: Install the World Engine extension (3D world model + compute offload). Default: on for workstation and compute, off for drone and ground station. An installed extension is left alone; plugin auto-update keeps it current. The last of --world-engine and --no-world-engine wins.
flags.name: --world-engine

flags.help: Skip the World Engine extension
flags.name: --no-world-engine

flags.help: Do not perform the single automatic reboot when provisioning needs one (a camera/display overlay, an I2C dtparam). The install then reports degraded and names what is still staged.
flags.name: --no-reboot

flags.help: Pairing code (or pass it positionally). On an already-installed box a bare code does a fast re-pair, not a reinstall.
flags.name: --pair

flags.help: Upgrade an existing install in place
flags.name: --upgrade

flags.help: Clear checkpoints and reinstall
flags.name: --force

flags.help: Proceed with an upgrade even when the vehicle is (or may be) armed
flags.name: --force-armed

flags.help: Install from a git branch (dev)
flags.name: --branch

flags.help: Release channel selector
flags.name: --channel

flags.help: Pin an explicit agent version
flags.name: --version

flags.help: Pin the agent package AND the prebuilt binaries to one revision, from that commit's rev-<sha> release. Requires the edge channel.
flags.name: --ref

flags.help: Install the service binaries from this directory of locally-built artifacts instead of fetching them. Each file is named for its service (ados-video) or its release asset (ados-video-aarch64) and needs its <name>.sha256 beside it; a service the directory does not carry still comes from the release. Requires the edge channel; not combinable with --ref. Linux only.
flags.name: --artifacts

flags.help: Display selection. `auto` (the ground-station default) auto-detects a panel; `none` opts out; an explicit id must be one the detected board declares.
flags.name: --display

flags.help: Camera hardware hint
flags.name: --camera

flags.help: Join this Wi-Fi network during a headless install (so the wired cable can be unplugged)
flags.name: --wifi-ssid

flags.help: File holding the --wifi-ssid password (omit if open; keeps it off the command line)
flags.name: --wifi-pass-file

flags.help: Plugin trust key (PEM) to copy into /etc/ados/plugin-keys/ on install. Repeatable.
flags.name: --plugin-key

flags.help: Remove the agent
flags.name: --uninstall

flags.help: Print install status and exit
flags.name: --status

flags.help: Plain line output (no animation/color)
flags.name: --plain

flags.help: Print only the final summary
flags.name: --quiet

flags.help: Machine output on stdout; no progress UI
flags.name: --json

flags.help: Disable color in the progress UI
flags.name: --no-color

flags.help: ASCII glyph fallback
flags.name: --ascii

flags.help: Accept the detected defaults; skip the interactive setup and install right away
flags.name: --yes

flags.help: Never prompt; run the silent, flag-driven install (the identity flags above are the automation surface)
flags.name: --non-interactive

flags.help: Print this help and exit
flags.name: --help
